skills.name: Rainbow Breath
skills.text: Deals damage equal to [ATK * 150%] and applies Bleed and Poison to all enemies for 3 turns. Bleed deals damage equal to the [Target’s maximum HP * 10%] per turn; Poison deals damage equal to [ATK * 75%] per turn.

skills.name: Extreme Cuteness
skills.text: Applies Bleed and Poison to all enemies in the front row for 3 turns. Bleed deals damage equal to the [Target’s maximum HP * 10%] per turn; Poison deals damage equal to [ATK * 75%] per turn.

skills.name: Furry Ball
skills.text: Deals 200% ATK damage to 3 random enemies, applies Bleed for 5% maximum HP for 2 turns, and reduces Speed by 40% for 3 turns.
skills.sourceText: Deals damage equal to [ATK * 200%] to 3 random enemies, inflicts Bleed on them, dealing damage equal to [5% their Max HP] per turn, and reduces their [SPD -40%] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Leaf Charge
skills.text: Deals [ATK*420%] damage to a single enemy and inflicts Bleed, dealing [ATK*75%] damage per turn for 2 turns.

skills.name: Shadow Strike
skills.text: Deals [ATK*300%] DMG to 1 random target and inflicts Poison for 2 turns. Poison deals [ATK*150%] DMG each turn and reduces the target's [SPD by 50%] while increasing [DMG Taken by 35%].
